d:
Guest in the Newsroom features one of India's most celebrated poets and writers — Waseem Barelvi.
In this heart warming and engaging conversation, Wasim sahab shares:
• A special phone call with Shah Rukh Khan
• His first memorable meeting with Jaun Elia
• A touching anecdote about Jagjit Singh and ghazals
With his soulful poetry and charming recitations, the atmosphere turned truly delightful.
Waseem Barelvi also spoke candidly about his thoughts on fellow poets and his journey through literature.
